anchor.title: Smiles instinctively; this usually happens randomly, especially while sleeping.

items.title: Switches things between their hands.
Rolls over both ways on their own.
Turns by rocking side to side while on their tummy.
Stands while holding on to something.
Rolls or moves around to go where they want.
Rolls from tummy to back.
Grabs two things, one in each hand.
Uses their arms and hands to help them sit without falling over.

anchor.title: Brings their hands to their mouth.

items.title: Listens with interest when you speak to them.
Looks for a toy that was just hidden.
Hits two things together.
Looks for an item they dropped on the floor.
Copies facial expressions.
Explores their own body using their hands.
Copies easy actions, like shaking a rattle.
Tests cause and effect by dropping an object and seeing if you'll pick it up.

anchor.title: Moves their arms around when they see something they like.

items.title: Answers with babbles when you talk to them.
Babbles like they are in conversation with you and takes turns talking.
Uses sounds like 'm, n, p, t, d' when babbling.
Uses different tones in their babbling.
Repeats 'baba' or 'dada' kind of sounds.
Asks for help by babbling.
Talks to other babies with babbles.
Makes guttural sounds, like 'ga' or 'gu'.

anchor.title: Stares at the person who is talking to them.

items.title: Lifts their arms to be carried.
When they hear their name, they move toward the person by crawling, walking, or turning in their direction.
Explores on their own with a caregiver nearby.
Gets upset when playtime is interrupted.
Shows preference for certain people.
Interacts with people they are familiar with by smiling and/or talking.
Enjoys playing on their own.
Repeats sounds or actions to get people to look.

calibration.title: Makes up things or people in pretend play.
